currentParagraphText: “Are you truly certain of your decision?” the Lodestar Matron asked, disappointment in her voice.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Are you truly certain of your decision?” the Lodestar Matron asked, disappointment in her voice.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I don’t easily change my mind,” Jake simply responded.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: His words instantly worsened the mood in the room as Jake refused to move even when a god directly proposed a deal. From the looks of it, everyone – besides probably Jacob and Bertram, who were auditioning for an Oscar – fully expected Jake to ultimately end up agreeing. Why wouldn’t they? In their minds, it was ludicrous to disrespect gods in any way, and Jake not accepting a god’s offer would definitely qualify as disrespectful in their minds.
